name: Kanoko Makoto
source:
The protagonist of this work and Azusa's former subordinate.

When fraud was uncovered due to a whistleblower from a business partner, he was abandoned by Azusa and forced to bear sole responsibility for the fraud while being reassigned to a menial position.

He harbors strong anger towards Azusa's treatment of him whom he respected and had feelings for but was beginning to feel reassured there was nothing he could do about the current situation.

He is currently being encouraged by a friend to change jobs for a fresh start.

[From [url=https://syuntada.com/boss/soga.html]official site[/url]]
